items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Ward' in a list of names from the discography ('...beside Ward and Bullock?'), but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond to or acknowledge this specific mention in the provided text, nor does he mention Ward himself.

ctx.x: Yes, they are. Well, from working together. See this Ernie Bullock, clarinet player, he was very good, of course his technique just fit what Jelly Roll was doing, and the men surrounded by him, you know, they knew just what riff he was going to play or in which direction he was going to lead them.
